comparison_harness_python:
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess


def failure_signature(log):
    lines = log.splitlines()
    errors = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if "Vulkan validation ERROR" in line:
            end = index + 1
            while end < len(lines) and not lines[end].startswith("[vk]"):
                end += 1
            errors.append(re.sub(r"0x[0-9a-f]+", "HANDLE", "\n".join(lines[index:end])))
    assertions = [line for line in lines if line.startswith(("FAIL:", "validation errors:", "2 FAILURE"))]
    return errors, assertions


def test_exact_pre_move_cull_failure_comparison():
    repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    script = subprocess.check_output(
        ["wslpath", "-w", str(repo / ".tmp/check-water-baseline.ps1")], text=True
    ).strip()
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe",
         "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", script],
        cwd=repo, env=os.environ.copy(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600,
    )
    assert result.returncode == 1, result.stdout + result.stderr
    candidate = failure_signature((repo / ".tmp/water-temporal-evidence/cull.log").read_text())
    baseline = failure_signature((repo / ".tmp/water-temporal-evidence/baseline-cull.log").read_text())
    assert len(candidate[0]) == len(baseline[0]) == 4
    assert baseline == candidate, (baseline, candidate)
normalization: For each validation ERROR, capture its line and continuations until the next [vk] line. Replace only regex 0x[0-9a-f]+ with HANDLE. Compare ordered full blocks and lines starting FAIL:, validation errors:, or 2 FAILURE. Exactly four hazards and matching assertion lists required.
